primary_claim: SAE features in ChessGPT previously identified as perfect classifiers of 'is the player to move in check' are largely tied to PGN-syntax position rather than being robust check-detectors, and patching a subset of these features causally increases the model's logit for the king-move token; but when the redundant '+' check-indicator token is omitted from input, these check-detecting SAE features almost never fire even though the model still predicts a legal move 60% of the time (down from ~100% with '+' present), indicating check-relevant information is also encoded elsewhere in the model.

effect.metric: probability of predicting a legal move when the redundant '+' check-indicator token is omitted from the PGN string

contradicts_or_qualifies: Karvonen et al. identified 30 SAE features as perfect classifiers of 'is in check'; this work finds about half of SAE features generally are tied to a specific PGN-syntax position, so many of the 30 'check' features may not actually be affecting the model's prediction in the '.' subset the original paper focused on
stated_future_work: Refine the automated labeling method, which is currently ad hoc for identifying interesting board-state properties
Determine what prevents the model from moving into check
Determine how the model maintains a reasonable rate of legal move prediction even without using the check-classifying features
Improve the basic methods for evaluating feature interpretability to find a strategy that generalizes beyond chess
Confirm that features indicating specific ways the king is in check cause moves that actually make sense (e.g. the king moves columns when attacked from above)
limitations_stated: Epistemic status: 5 days of hacking, and there could be bugs the authors haven't caught
The categorization of PGN pattern positions ('dot', 'column', 'piece', etc.) is an arbitrary first-pass breakdown, not confirmed to be the 'right' one
It is possible the authors have not found a way of thinking about the board that aligns perfectly with how the model represents it
quote: Patching the activation of these features to be high is sufficient for dramatically increasing the logit for K, indicating that the model is indeed behaving as if it is in check from this intervention.
